newsitem.title: EGYPT: Three dead in Cairo building collapse.
newsitem.headline: Three dead in Cairo building collapse.

text.p: Three people were killed and at least 100 others are feared dead after an apartment block collapsed in a Cairo suburb on Sunday.
A Reuters correspondent at the site saw rescue workers carry away a corspe on a stretcher covered with a green blanket.
The work of rescue teams had been hampered for some time when they had difficulty getting equipment onto the site, which is situated on a narrow road.
The crews are now using bulldozers to clear away the debris and are expected to find more corpses or survivors in the next few hours.

Egyptian Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri told Reuters that rescue workers had so far pulled out 19 survivors and were franctically searching beneath the concrete slabs and metal girders for more people.
Doctor Tala'at Ezzedine of the nearby Manshiyet Bakry hospital said rescue crews had found 17 people in the rubble. He said two later died and that the other 15 were being treated for injuries.
The porter of the 11-storey building said he thought renovation work in one of the 40 apartments might have affected the infrastructure and caused the collapse.
Local residents said the landlord had erected seven illegal floors and that the local council had been demanding their removal since 1991.
